Riot IQ | Software Engineers, Product Designers, AI Native Fresh Grads | Seattle, WA | REMOTE (US) | Full time | https://riotiq.com

I'm Robert, cofounder of Riot IQ. We're building RIOT IQ, a professional online IQ testing and cognitive assessment platform for psychologists, researchers, clinicians, employers, institutions, and curious individuals.

We're US based and 100% remote. We are hiring software engineers, full stack engineers, product designers, design engineers, and AI native fresh grads.

The most interesting project is building an AI based human intelligence predictor using our in house assessment data. That means working with response patterns, timing data, item performance, scoring, validation, dashboards, model evaluation, privacy, and product UX.

You might work on a variety of things as well but all related to predicting human intelligence.

What matters most to us:

1. Strong product sense 2. Clear communication 3. High ownership 4. Taste in software, design, and user experience 5. Fast learning 6. Interest in AI, cognitive science, psychometrics, or research tools

Useful experience includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node, Postgres, Python, data pipelines, ML workflows, dashboards, edtech, healthcare, or research tools.

Compensation is $90k to $180k depending on role and experience, with equity for the right long term hires. Visa sponsorship is not available right now.

To apply, email robertneir@riotiq.com with your resume or LinkedIn, GitHub or portfolio, and a short note on what you would want to build at Riot IQ.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/robertmneir

We are actively hiring and will reply to applicants.
